text: Completed PyBIDS padded-run parity with run-only canonical exact matching and a dedicated indexed candidate map; subject and echo stay lexical per the PyBIDS 0.22 entity registry. Added checked BidsQuery.run(Int), nonnegative validation, JVM/JS example and generated arbitrary-padding tests, and a run=1 checksum/timing workload. Final 6,281-file court matched 1,536 paths exactly; directional median 0.6284 ms bids4s vs 22.5451 ms PyBIDS (35.88x), 2,067,355 bytes/op. Final gates: 89 JVM and 71 JS tests on Scala 3.3.8/3.4.2/3.7.4, benchmark smoke, version policy, static checks, and coverage 82.08% statements/73.11% branches.
